acceptance.given: The frozen FR, NFR, guardrail, and retained historical sub-duty sources are available before implementation begins.

oracle.expected: The Exact-Cover source-universe check records an independently decidable Atomic Obligation for every required source category before implementation is allowed to proceed.
forbidden: Implementation begins with an uncovered FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, or retained historical sub-duty.
An Atomic Obligation is accepted without independent decidability.
oracle.observable: Before implementation, the Exact-Cover validation artifact maps every required source category to independently decidable Atomic Obligations.

acceptance.then: The complete required source universe is established as the basis for Exact Cover before implementation.
acceptance.when: The Exact-Cover source-universe validation is evaluated immediately before implementation authorization.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one required FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, or retained historical sub-duty from the Atomic-Obligation mapping and verify that the Exact-Cover validator rejects the incomplete universe.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain Exact-Cover validation reject implementation readiness unless every FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, and retained historical sub-duty is represented by an independently decidable Atomic Obligation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; removing the validation preserves prior Toolchain behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unvalidated source universe -> complete independently decidable Atomic-Obligation universe before implementation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator rejects any source-universe omission or non-independent Atomic Obligation and accepts only complete pre-implementation decomposition.

acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer has a bound Prior Route identity and baseline verdict and diagnostic category, plus a current Candidate Route.

oracle.expected: Real Consumer call receipts show enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable; after the sequence the observed Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category equal the captured baseline.
forbidden: Prior Route identity is not restored.
The verdict baseline is not restored.
The diagnostic baseline is not restored.
Configuration-only switching is treated as behavioral rollback.
oracle.observable: The Consumer-transition result contains real-call observations for all four transitions and a final comparison with the captured Prior Route baseline.

acceptance.then: The Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline are restored after the complete transition sequence.
acceptance.when: The applicable Consumer executes enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use a controlled Consumer transition whose rollback receipt has a changed Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category and observe the behavior test fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable through each applicable real Consumer call surface and compare the final Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic baseline with the captured baseline.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Route-transition evidence remains non-authorizing and rollback restores the Prior Route baseline without schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: Bound Prior Route baseline -> Candidate enabled -> Prior Route invoked for disable and rollback -> Candidate re-enabled with Prior Route baseline restored.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every applicable Consumer has real-call receipts for all four transitions, and the final observed Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category equal its captured baseline.

acceptance.given: The Exact-Cover graph identifies its nonbehavioral Atomic Obligations and their declared violation witnesses.

oracle.expected: Exact-Cover validation maps every nonbehavioral Atomic Obligation to a deterministic violation witness that reproducibly rejects its specified violation.
forbidden: A nonbehavioral obligation lacks a deterministic violation witness.
A nondeterministic witness is accepted for a nonbehavioral obligation.
oracle.observable: The Exact-Cover witness mapping and deterministic negative-validator result associate every nonbehavioral obligation with a reproducible violation witness.

acceptance.then: Every nonbehavioral Exact-Cover obligation has a deterministic violation witness.
acceptance.when: Exact Cover is constructed or validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or make nondeterministic the declared violation witness for one nonbehavioral Atomic Obligation and observe the Exact-Cover negative validation fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain Exact-Cover verifier to bind each nonbehavioral Atomic Obligation to a deterministic violation witness and reject missing or nondeterministic witness mappings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; removal restores the prior verifier behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Nonbehavioral obligations with unverified witness mappings -> each mapping validated against a deterministic violation witness.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Exact-Cover validator rejects every missing or nondeterministic nonbehavioral witness mapping.

acceptance.given: An aggregate execution is configured with a finite output limit.

oracle.expected: During aggregate evaluation, captured output is measured against the configured finite limit and budget exhaustion produces an unsuccessful terminal result.
forbidden: An aggregate produces output without a bound.
Output budget exhaustion is treated as successful.
oracle.observable: The aggregate execution result records its configured finite output limit, measured output, and deterministic unsuccessful terminal state when the limit is exhausted.

acceptance.then: The aggregate remains within its configured finite output bound or terminates unsuccessfully without reducing coverage.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run an aggregate fixture that exceeds its configured finite output capture limit and verify deterministic unsuccessful termination with coverage preserved.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce configured finite output capture for aggregate Toolchain execution, report budget exhaustion as unsuccessful, and preserve required coverage accounting.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; rollback removes only aggregate output-bound enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate output capture starts within a configured finite bound -> aggregate completes within the bound or terminates unsuccessfully on exhaustion.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every aggregate result has a finite configured output bound; exhaustion is unsuccessful and does not reduce coverage.
